title: Take the seeded candidate when a seeded retry's producer adds nothing
summary: In run.rs (~line 1761) the idle-producer check fails a seeded retry whose work tree is unchanged since the seed, even though the seed already differs from the base. Fix: fail only when the change list against the base is empty; when seeded and unchanged but the change list is non-empty, keep the seeded candidate and continue to admission, checks and the verifier. Audience: the Athena operator whose retries lose complete candidates.

defaults_applied.how: Two new tests; fmt, clippy -D warnings and tests must pass.
Tests exercise the seeded no-change run reaching the verifier and landing, and the unseeded failure.
Fix the idle-producer condition itself, not the one job.
The check is that the seeded candidate reaches the verifier.
One focused change in run.rs plus changelog.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: changes is the snapshot's change list against the base, so a seeded unchanged tree has a non-empty list; the fix is to fail only when changes.is_empty().
A seeded retry whose seed equals the base (empty change list) still fails as today.
Tests go in run.rs's existing test module using its fake producer; no changes to snapshot.rs are needed.
No athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow change is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in run.rs seeds a retry from a kept candidate with a fake producer that makes no change; the run reaches checks and the verifier and lands. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
A new test shows an unseeded run whose fake producer makes no change still fails with the outcome 'the producer made no change'. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing that a seeded retry whose producer adds nothing now goes on with the seeded candidate.
The condition near run.rs line 1761 fails only when there is no change against the base; the comment explains the seeded case.

out_of_scope: Changing how retry seeds are chosen or stored
Changing the checks or verifier logic
urgent_reason: Cuts failed retries and redo work, since complete seeded candidates currently fail before the verifier.
hard_reason: Changes the run loop that decides what reaches checks, the verifier and landing.
